result.stdout:
Description:
  Work with PowerPoint (.pptx) files

Usage:
  clippit pptx [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information

Commands:
  split <input>   Split a .pptx file into individual single-slide files.
  
                  Examples:
                    clippit pptx split deck.pptx --slides 1,3,6-9 --output slides
                    clippit pptx split deck.pptx --output slides --manifest
                    cat deck.pptx | clippit pptx split - --output slides --format json
  build           Build a presentation from a manifest that assembles source .pptx files into sections.
  
                  Examples:
                    clippit pptx build init --output deck.json
                    clippit pptx build run deck.json --output final.pptx
  verify <input>  Validate that a .pptx file is a correct OpenXml presentation.
  
                  Examples:
                    clippit pptx verify deck.pptx
                    clippit pptx verify deck.pptx --format json
                    clippit pptx verify deck.pptx --office-version Office2021
                    cat deck.pptx | clippit pptx verify - --format json

result.stdout:
Description:
  Work with Word (.docx) files

Usage:
  clippit word [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information

Commands:
  build                               Build a merged Word document from a manifest that combines multiple .docx sources.
  
                                      Examples:
                                        clippit word build init --output word-build.json
                                        clippit word build run word-build.json --output merged.docx
  accept-revisions <input>            Accept all tracked revisions in a .docx file.
  
                                      Examples:
                                        clippit word accept-revisions draft.docx
                                        clippit word accept-revisions draft.docx --output clean.docx --format json
                                        cat draft.docx | clippit word accept-revisions - --output clean.docx
                                        clippit word accept-revisions draft.docx --output - > clean.docx
  assemble <template> <data>          Assemble a .docx document from a template and XML data.
  
                                      Examples:
                                        clippit word assemble template.docx data.xml
                                        clippit word assemble template.docx data.xml --output generated.docx --format json
                                        clippit word assemble template.docx - --output generated.docx
                                        clippit word assemble template.docx data.xml --output - > generated.docx
  compare <source> <revised>          Compare two .docx files and produce a result with tracked revisions.
  
                                      Examples:
                                        clippit word compare before.docx after.docx
                                        clippit word compare before.docx after.docx --output compared.docx --format json
                                        clippit word 
[truncated]

result.stdout:
Description:
  Work with Excel (.xlsx) files

Usage:
  clippit excel [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information

Commands:
  verify <input>   Validate that a .xlsx file is a correct OpenXml spreadsheet.
  
                   Examples:
                     clippit excel verify spreadsheet.xlsx
                     clippit excel verify spreadsheet.xlsx --format json
                     clippit excel verify spreadsheet.xlsx --office-version Office2021
                     cat spreadsheet.xlsx | clippit excel verify - --format json
  to-html <input>  Convert a spreadsheet range, sheet, or table to HTML/CSS.
  
                   Examples:
                     clippit excel to-html spreadsheet.xlsx -o sheet.html
                     clippit excel to-html spreadsheet.xlsx --sheet "Q3 Data" --range "B2:F15"
                     clippit excel to-html spreadsheet.xlsx --table "SalesTable" -o - > table.html
  create <input>   Generate an Excel (.xlsx) workbook from a JSON workbook definition.
  
                   Examples:
                     clippit excel create report.json
                     clippit excel create report.json --output report.xlsx --format json
                     cat report.json | clippit excel create - --output report.xlsx
                     clippit excel create report.json --output - > report.xlsx

  clippit install [options]

  -?, -h, --help                 Show help and usage information

Description:
  Split a .pptx file into individual single-slide files.
  
  Examples:
    clippit pptx split deck.pptx --slides 1,3,6-9 --output slides
    clippit pptx split deck.pptx --output slides --manifest
    cat deck.pptx | clippit pptx split - --output slides --format json

Usage:
  clippit pptx split <input> [options]

Arguments:
  <input>  Path to the source .pptx file to split. Use '-' to read from stdin.

Options:
  -o, --output <output>          Output directory for the individual slide files (default: same directory as input, or the current directory when reading from stdin).
  -s, --slides <slides>          Slides to extract. Syntax: comma-separated list of 1-based slide numbers and/or inclusive ranges, e.g. '1,3,6-9'. Whitespace allowed around separators. Duplicates are deduplicated. Default: all slides.
  --force                        Overwrite existing output files. Without this flag the command fails on the first collision.
  --manifest                     Also write a deck manifest (clippit pptx build run compatible) alongside the slides. Path: <outputDir>/<sourceBaseName>.manifest.json (or stdin.manifest.json for stdin input). Preserves source PPTX sections when present.
  -f, --format <Auto|Json|Text>  Output format: json | text. Defaults to json when stdout is piped, text on a terminal. [default: Auto]
  -q, --quiet                    Suppress the success summary on stdout. Errors and exit codes are unaffected.
  -?, -h, --help                 Show help and usage information

                    cat word-build.json | clippit word build run - --output - > merged.docx
